fact: At the first DOUNIA conference on 30 April 2025 in Conakry, whose aim was to draw up a national data and AI strategy, the digital economy minister called for the data protection law to be adopted, and a document of preliminary recommendations was to be written as the basis of a future national data and AI strategy; no drafting of the strategy itself had begun.
title: DounIA 2025 : une conférence pour la co-construction d’une stratégie nationale sur les données numériques et l’intelligence artificielle en Guinée
